Mahabharat ka woh yoddha,
jise Bhagwan Krishna ne teen hazaar saal tak bhatakne ka shraap diya tha!
Uska naam tha Ashwatthama.
Woh Guru Dronacharya ka putra aur ek mahaan yoddha tha.
Uske maathe par janm se hi ek divya mani thi,
jo use kai khatron se bachaati thi.
Lekin Mahabharat ke yuddh mein apne pita ki mrityu ke baad
Ashwatthama badle ki aag mein andha ho gaya.
Yuddh samaapt hone ke baad,
ek raat usne Pandavon ke shivir mein so rahe Draupadi ke paanchon putron ki hatya kar di.
Jab Arjun ne use pakadne ki koshish ki,
toh Ashwatthama ne Brahmashirastra chala diya.
Arjun ne bhi apna divya astra chalaaya.
Lekin Ashwatthama ne apne astra ko Uttara ke garbh mein pal rahe bachche ki or mod diya.
Woh bachcha tha Parikshit.
Bhagwan Krishna ne uski raksha ki
aur Ashwatthama ko teen hazaar saal tak peeda ke saath bhatakne ka shraap diya.
Uske maathe ki mani bhi usse chheen li gayi.
Is tarah ek mahaan yoddha ko apni hi galtiyon ki aisi saza mili,
jisse use mukti nahi mili.
Kyunki kabhi-kabhi badle ki aag dushman se pehle khud insaan ko jala deti hai.
